citation.authors: Alshahrani I, Kamran MA, Alhaizaey A, Abumelha N
citation.title: Evaluation of skeletal variations and establishment of Cephalometric Norms in Saudi Sub Population using Bjork Jarabak's analysis

scale.source: Methods: calibrated with the Dolphin ruler

curation.notes: Set id alshahrani2018 (ruling P46): the extractions are named khan-bjork-jarabak.{a,b}.json after the brief's wrong author name. Compared 2026-10-08 (norms:compare a vs b exit 1, 14 differences, all source wording; logs/task9b2-compare-khan-bjork-jarabak.log). All 14 means, SDs and n agree; every one re-read from Tables III and IV with the PubMed full-text tool (PMC6191777, DOI 10.12669/pjms.345.15556; rule P44, article text not saved): agree. Decisions: source wording -> table, row and column with PMC6191777 (print page not given; article pp. 1104-1109) (merge notes). Citation authors as PubMed lists them (b; a wrote 'Khan et al.'). Rows using gonion close: Table I defines 'Gonion constructed' (C3). Women's sum 397.302 kept as printed (parts 395.352), ratio SD '± 3' as printed. Scale true-size: both extractors (Methods: the software was calibrated for magnification with a known distance on the Dolphin ruler). Selection class-I: BSI Class I incisors, normal occlusion, little or no crowding, no skeletal abnormality, no prior orthodontics (Methods); no facial-balance criterion.

caveats: Authors: PubMed lists Alshahrani I, Kamran MA, Alhaizaey A, Abumelha N; earlier briefs called this paper 'Khan' (corrected, ruling P46).

Sample: 100 non-growing Saudi patients (50 M, 50 F), 17-22 y, King Khalid University, Abha; normal occlusion (BSI Class I incisors), no orthodontic history, little or no crowding, no skeletal abnormality, parents and grandparents Saudi; convenience sampling (Methods).
Film cephalograms in natural head posture, scanned and traced in Dolphin Imaging 11 (Methods).
Gonion is constructed (Table I: 'Gonion constructed'); the app's Go is the AI's anatomical gonion (C3), so every row using Go is close.

Not in the catalogue: anterior cranial base S-N (M 74.644 ± 4.851, F 68.08 ± 4.851), posterior cranial base S-Ar (M 34.18 ± 5.591, F 31.11 ± 4.241), ramus height Ar-Go (M 49.340 ± 4.797, F 44.250 ± 5.597), mandibular body length Go-Me (M 78.327, SD printed '6626'; F 74.970 ± 6.135) mm. The catalogue's ratios #43 (S-N/Go-Me) and #44 (Ar-S/Ar-Go) are not tabled and are not computed from the means.
The men's Go-Me SD is printed '6626' (a missing decimal point); not entered (the length is not a catalogue measurement anyway).
Upper and lower gonial angles (#37, #38) are defined in Table I but no values are tabled.
Copy-editing slips in the paper: the Statistical Analysis and Discussion mention 'Pakistani adults'; Table II's p-values repeat some of Table III's. Values entered as printed.
Tables III-IV also print Jarabak's own norms beside the Saudi values; those are a separate set (jarabak-via-alshahrani2018).
